$comment: The explanatory guides and the two index pages that gather them. The cash-out guide carries the site's strongest safety warning; its wording is not negotiable in any language.

cashOut.intro: The official process, what to have ready before you start, and how to recognise the services that are not worth the risk.
cashOut.processDescription: At a high level, and only as far as official documentation supports.
cashOut.processDiagramCaption: The stage drawn with a dashed edge is the one you do not control. Everything before it is preparation; nothing after it is guaranteed.
cashOut.prepareDescription: None of this is difficult, but chasing it after submitting is what causes delays.
cashOut.howLongDescription: Honestly: nobody outside Roblox can tell you.
cashOut.avoidDescription: This part matters more than the rest of the page.
cashOut.groupDescription: A DevEx request is submitted by one account and paid to that account. Roblox does not divide a payout between collaborators, so a revenue share is an arrangement between the people in the group — and the minimum applies to each of them separately.
cashOut.afterDescription: The DevEx rate is not the last number involved.

safety.p1: No legitimate service needs your Roblox password, and this site never asks for it. Services offering to buy your Robux, convert a balance outside DevEx, or speed up a payout generally violate the Roblox Terms of Use. The realistic outcomes are losing the Robux, losing the account, or both.
safety.p2: DevEx is the only official route from Earned Robux to money. There is no faster alternative.
safety.p3: Anyone guaranteeing approval is guaranteeing something they do not control.

group.p1: This catches groups out more often than the rate does. A team can earn several times the minimum together and still have nobody able to submit a request, because the threshold is measured against the balance one person holds. Work out what each agreed share comes to, and whether it clears on its own:

after.p1: A payout is income, and how it is taxed depends entirely on where you live. Your payment provider may charge a fee, and if you are paid in a currency other than US dollars there will be a conversion spread on top.
after.p2: Model those deductions with your own figures

prose.noGuaranteedTime: Roblox does not publish a guaranteed processing time, so this page does not state one. Specific numbers of days quoted elsewhere are other creators’ experiences, not commitments — and one person’s timeline says nothing reliable about yours. If a request seems stuck, Roblox support is the only party who can actually look at it.
prose.submitPortal: Requests go through the official portal linked from the {creatorHub}.

avoid.phishing: A site asking you to sign in with your Roblox account to “check eligibility” is phishing.
avoid.generators: Robux “generators” do not exist. Every one of them is a scam or a survey farm.
